test_objective: If a Subscription defines a throttling member, a Notification shall not be sent if the throttling specified (in seconds) has not elapsed yet.

test_cases.name: 046_15_01 Check that a notification is not sent if the throttling has not elapsed yet
test_cases.doc: If a Subscription defines a throttling member, a Notification shall not be sent if the throttling specified (in seconds) has not elapsed yet.
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/entities/{entityId}/attrs/{attributeId}'
        method set to 'PATCH'
        Update Entity Attributes and
    Query Parameter: id set to '${entity_id}' and
    Query Parameter: fragment_filename set to 'airQualityLevel-fragment.jsonld' and
    Query Parameter: content_type set to 'application/ld+json'
}
